cd /root/nanobot-src && git add nanobot/groupchat/orchestra/broadcast.py nanobot/groupchat/orchestra/mailbox.py && git commit -m "fix(groupchat): eliminate agent deadlock from busy-replier misjudgment and infinite wait loops

Three fixes targeting the root cause of agents getting stuck:

1. mailbox.py: Tighten busy-replier check — only agents inside
   tool_loop (tracked by _busy_agents) count as busy repliers.
   Previously, agents in the gap between tool_loop exit and
   auto-wait entry were falsely considered busy, blocking the
   caller for 60s.

2. broadcast.py: Add consecutive wait-timeout guard — after 3
   consecutive empty waits (no incoming messages), non-leader
   agents auto-exit (done) instead of looping forever.

3. broadcast.py: Reset consecutive-wait counter on successful
   output, leader forced synthesis, and real message receipt,
   ensuring normal interaction is never mis-killed."
cd /root/nanobot-src && git diff HEAD -- nanobot/groupchat/orchestra/mailbox.py nanobot/groupchat/orchestra/broadcast.py

args.content:
2026-05-26 提交 19e9104: fix(groupchat) 消除 agent 卡死
三处修复：
1. mailbox.py _get_busy_expected_repliers 加入 `and other in self._busy_agents`，空白期不再误判为 busy
2. broadcast.py 连续 wait-timeout 计数器，3次空等后自动退出 done
3. broadcast.py 计数器重置点：成功产出(L1026)、Leader synthesis(L1340)、收到真实消息(L1361)
根因：agent 在 tool_loop 结束和 auto-wait 之间的空白期被误判为 busy，导致其他 agent 被 60s 延长等待卡住
